name: Removing one cart line keeps the other
description: With two different items, Remove must delete only the chosen line.

planSteps.description: On the shop page, click "Add to cart" for Bud Vase once
Click "Add to cart" for Planter once
Click the Cart link in the store header
Click the Remove button on the Planter line
The cart still lists Bud Vase
The cart no longer lists Planter
